stability_rows.stability_object: Archive package integrity, generated-surface consistency, and provenance/custody records.
stability_rows.positivity_or_boundedness_condition: Package integrity supplies no physical energy bound, spectral positivity, vacuum lifetime, ghost/tachyon/gradient analysis, or mode-stability guarantee.
stability_rows.instability_failure_mode: A clean package can coexist with unstable vacua, negative-norm states, runaway modes, ghost degrees of freedom, or unstable numerical/likelihood targets.
stability_rows.stability_test: Only packaging and generated-surface stability are tested; no physical stability or positivity condition is established.
stability_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer stable dynamics, positive-energy spectrum, viable vacuum, or route promotion from metadata/provenance wrappers.
